answers.label: Wide Reach Guards in the middle of every row cover the whole sweep
Living Shelter and Keep the Heat In on every row blunt the waves
Squelch Song keeps Mired on the Wyrm, so Forge Heat cannot build and each hit lands softer
Circle Round and Clear the Air heal the Payoffs its reflected hits land on
Tunnel Through gets hits past her thick bark
Lantern Glow keeps the creatures beside it from falling quiet at the row ends
Draw Fire pulls the Rod onto a Guard that can take it
Catch the Bolts and Guards beside the Payoffs take the aimed strikes
Mud Wall keeps Mired on it while Drizzle and Hearth keep the most hurt up
Hearth at round start heals the creatures the fen sinks first
